According to a PolitiFact fact-check, the claim that Chuck Schumer was caught on a hot mic plotting to "blame REPUBLICANS AND MAGA" for reform delays is **False**. [PolitiFact](https://www.politifact.com/factchecks/2024/mar/01/instagram-posts/schumer-biden-discussed-election-not-blaming-repub/) reports that the video circulating on social media was altered.

The video actually shows Schumer and President Joe Biden discussing the state of the 2022 midterm elections at an airport. Schumer was heard discussing the debate in the Pennsylvania U.S. Senate race and expressing concern about the Georgia U.S. Senate race. There was no discussion of delaying reforms or blaming Republicans. News coverage of the hot mic moment also confirms they were discussing midterm elections.

Reports from other sources indicate that some onlookers shouted "Go home, Joe!" and "You’re a loser!" as Biden arrived.
